evidence.runtime_round_test: Local Node DOM harness executed the actual lace v8.5 generator path with default parameters: 423 nodes generated; round policy complete; 8 joined rounds checked; exactly one explicit closesRound join in every round; validation PASS after correcting R8 edge-path anchoring.
evidence.round_semantics_finding: A joined-round closing slip may legitimately work into an earlier structural/base anchor, including a prior-round stitch. Validator v1.2 therefore requires the closure anchor to be in the current round, requires the target to exist already, and rejects future/forward targets instead of incorrectly requiring every closure target to belong to the current round.

This run used that distinction to keep joined/spiral semantics explicit rather than inferred from visual role names.
